Start an adaptive test

Source: R/fct_cat.R
cat_start.Rd

Starts a computerized adaptive test (CAT) over the chosen scales of an item bank, one scale at a time, in the order given. Each scale is tested with the engine of its IRT model (any of irt_models): each next item is the most informative one left at the current estimate (maximum Fisher information); after each answer the ability is estimated again by EAP, with the normal prior of the scale, over a grid of \(\pm 6\) prior standard deviations. A scale stops when the standard error, divided by the prior standard deviation, is at most se_threshold, or when its items run out; the test then moves to the next scale.

Usage

cat_start(bank, scales = unique(bank$scale), se_threshold = 0.45)

Arguments

bank

An item bank read with read_questionnaire.

scales

The scales to test, in order.

se_threshold

Standardized standard error at which a scale stops.

Value

A CAT session: a list to pass to cat_answer, cat_item and cat_results. Its stage is "testing" until the last scale stops, then "done"; progress has one row per scale and log one row per answer.

Details

Abilities and standard errors are reported standardized per scale (divided by the prior standard deviation), so the same threshold is the same target in every scale: a threshold se aims at a reliability of about \(1 - se^2\).

See also

Other CAT session: cat_answer(), cat_item(), cat_results(), plot_cat_trajectory()

Examples

q <- read_questionnaire(example_questionnaires()[3]) # IPIP-50, graded response model
s <- cat_start(q, scales = "Extraversion", se_threshold = 0.45)
while (s$stage == "testing") s <- cat_answer(s, 4) # always "Moderately accurate"
cat_results(s)
#>          scale     theta        se percentile answered total    status
#> 1 Extraversion 0.4534394 0.4414101   67.48838        2    10 completed
s$log
#>   step        scale                                        question answer score     theta        se
#> 1    1 Extraversion I talk to a lot of different people at parties.      4     3 0.5009819 0.5880331
#> 2    2 Extraversion                          I start conversations.      4     3 0.4534394 0.4414101
